program.name: Circuit Then Swings
program.subject: Kettlebell only
program.blurb: A one-bell strength circuit, then a swing EMOM to finish.
program.about: Strength in a circuit, then swings on the minute. Each day is a circuit of three kettlebell moves, round after round, then a short EMOM of swings and other ballistic moves. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations.
program.split: Bell circuit, then a swing EMOM, A / B
